description.value: Pho Willoughby is a Vietnamese restaurant in Willoughby Town Centre in Langley Township, serving classic dishes including pho and banh mi. The restaurant offers both dine-in and takeout options with online ordering and reservations. It would be a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through the Willoughby commercial hub.

address.value: 20780 Willoughby Town Centre Drive, Langley, BC V2Y 1X1

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: rack (5 spaces) at 32m; bollard (2 spaces) at 44m; bollard (2 spaces) at 52m; rack (5 spaces) at 52m; bollard (2 spaces) at 52m; stands (6 spaces) at 76m; stands (4 spaces) at 97m. Total: 26 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active Vietnamese restaurant at the same address as OSM. The website explicitly lists 'Takeaway' as a service option. A phone number discrepancy exists: OSM records +1-778-705-2051 while the website footer shows (778) 298-9139 — the website value is used as more current. No bike-specific amenities, washrooms, or water refill are mentioned on the website.
concerns: Phone number mismatch: OSM records +1-778-705-2051 but the website footer shows (778) 298-9139. Website value used as likely more current.
Website footer states 'Open 24 hours' which is implausible for a full-service restaurant and is likely a placeholder or template error.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, publicly accessible Vietnamese restaurant with a functioning website and online ordering — a useful food stop for touring cyclists in Langley.
